source.advice: Please factory reset the shop hub.

result.next_step: The step is not one clearly chosen operation. Ask the customer exactly: "A reboot briefly interrupts service; a factory reset removes settings. Which action, if any, do you want?" Then select only what they choose.

execution.disruption_boundary: A factory reset erases every setting on the hub, including the Wi-Fi name, password and port forwarding, then restarts it. Internet and Wi-Fi drop for about 10 minutes, and every device must reconnect with the default password printed on the hub.
execution.next_step: Give the receipt and restate the disruption boundary. Offer to run run_line_diagnostics again in a few minutes. Do not start another step unless the customer chooses one.
